comparison.objective: Insert a PH2 bit into an electric screwdriver holder; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-shank phase alignment and tight insertion while steadying a tool versus coaxial adjustment and countertorque locking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct bit fully seated and released versus target opening locked and retained through three actuations.
comparison.reason: Precision tool insertion does not test setting preservation under locknut reaction.
